snippet.title: Age of Legacy - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Age of Legacy is an unforgiving roguelike RPG with intense turn-based 1v1 combat. Step into a world where survival is earned, not given. With no allies to assist you, every battle is a high-stakes duel, testing your build optimization and tactical foresight to the limit.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3588980/Age_of_Legacy/
